brief:
Israeli restrictions in Hebron have severely limited Palestinian movement within the city, according to Al Jazeera English. Gates and checkpoints controlled by Israeli forces have fragmented the urban area, forcing Palestinians to navigate complex routes and navigate multiple security barriers in their daily lives.

The checkpoints have created significant hardship for residents attempting to access basic services, employment, and family connections across different parts of the city. Palestinians face lengthy delays and uncertainty when moving between neighborhoods, effectively confining entire communities behind barriers.
dek: Israeli restrictions in Hebron have made life for Palestinians from the city a daily ordeal.
title: Israeli checkpoints transform Hebron into ghost town for Palestinians
